declared: 2026-09-22, before the first comparison run; not edited afterwards (notes may be added)
extra_wavelengths_note: reported in the tables for information; the criteria apply at 1.55 um only

focal_position.metric: absolute difference of the on-axis intensity peak position (three-point parabola through the largest sample of the axis line)

fwhm.metric: relative difference of the focal-plane intensity FWHM (linear interpolation of the half-maximum crossings), |a-b| / mean(a,b)

profile_rms.metric: RMS over the focal line of the difference of the two intensity profiles (each relative to its own bare-cell incident intensity), divided by the mean of the two peaks

efficiency.metric: absolute difference of the focusing efficiency: y-directed power within 1.5 FWHM of the focal-plane peak divided by the bare-cell power through the aperture line

focal_position.metric: absolute difference of the on-axis intensity peak position (three-point parabola through the largest sample of the axis row of the xz section)

fwhm_x.metric: relative difference of the focal-plane FWHM along x through the peak, |a-b| / mean(a,b)

fwhm_y.metric: relative difference of the focal-plane FWHM along y through the peak, |a-b| / mean(a,b)

profile_rms.metric: RMS over the focal-plane map of the difference of the two intensity maps (each relative to its own bare-cell incident intensity), divided by the mean of the two peaks

efficiency.metric: absolute difference of the focusing efficiency: z-directed power within a rectangle of 1.5 FWHM_x by 1.5 FWHM_y around the focal-plane peak divided by the bare-cell power through the aperture plane
